measurements.name: cuda_fp32_gflops
measurements.method: 8 independent FFMA chains x 4096 iterations at full occupancy; 2 flops per FFMA

measurements.name: cuda_int32_gops
measurements.method: 8 independent integer multiply-add chains x 4096 iterations at full occupancy; constants are kernel arguments, loop not unrolled

measurements.name: sfu_exp2_gops
measurements.method: exp2f, 8 dependent chains x 4096 iterations

measurements.name: sfu_rsqrt_gops
measurements.method: rsqrtf, 8 dependent chains x 4096 iterations

measurements.name: tc_fp16_gflops
measurements.method: 4 independent __builtin_mxc_mma_16x16x16f16 chains per wave x 4096 iterations; 8192 flops per instruction

measurements.name: smem_gbps
measurements.method: conflict-free volatile shared loads, 8 per iteration x 4096 iterations

measurements.name: smem_conflict_ratio_w2
measurements.method: elapsed of the same loop with a `ways`-way bank conflict, relative to the conflict-free loop

measurements.name: smem_conflict_ratio_w4
measurements.method: elapsed of the same loop with a `ways`-way bank conflict, relative to the conflict-free loop

measurements.name: smem_conflict_ratio_w8
measurements.method: elapsed of the same loop with a `ways`-way bank conflict, relative to the conflict-free loop

measurements.name: smem_conflict_ratio_w16
measurements.method: elapsed of the same loop with a `ways`-way bank conflict, relative to the conflict-free loop

measurements.name: smem_conflict_ratio_w32
measurements.method: elapsed of the same loop with a `ways`-way bank conflict, relative to the conflict-free loop

measurements.name: smem_conflict_slope
measurements.method: least squares through the origin of t(w)/t(1) against w over the ways whose ratio exceeds 1.05; the cost model applies max(1, slope * ways)

measurements.name: smem_occupancy_gbps
measurements.method: the conflict-free ld.shared loop at a fixed CTAs-per-SM instead of the resident maximum; the recorded value is the 1 CTA/SM point and the curve carries the rest

measurements.name: l1_latency_ns
measurements.method: single-thread pointer chase, random single cycle over the 0 MiB working set at one cache line per hop, 4096 hops, empty launch subtracted

measurements.name: l2_latency_ns
measurements.method: single-thread pointer chase, random single cycle over the 8 MiB working set at one cache line per hop, 65536 hops, empty launch subtracted

measurements.name: dram_latency_ns
measurements.method: single-thread pointer chase, random single cycle over the 512 MiB working set at one cache line per hop, 2000000 hops, empty launch subtracted

measurements.name: l2_gbps
measurements.method: volatile 16-byte streaming read, plateau (maximum) of the working-set sweep

measurements.name: dram_gbps
measurements.method: same sweep, median of the 512-2048 MiB working sets (achieved, not peak)

measurements.name: l2_knee_bytes
measurements.method: largest working set of the sweep still within 95% of the plateau bandwidth

measurements.name: atomic_uncontended_ns
measurements.method: one CTA, dependent chain of 2048 global atomicAdd; the return value feeds the next address so this is latency, not issue rate

measurements.name: atomic_contention_ns
measurements.method: N CTAs hammering one address; the recorded value is inverse throughput (elapsed / N / iters), which is what T_sync = |image(C_kappa)| * latency multiplies

measurements.name: threadfence_ns
measurements.method: store + __threadfence loop at full occupancy, minus the same loop without the fence

measurements.name: syncthreads_ns
measurements.method: one CTA of 128 threads per AP; shared counter bumped by thread 0 and read by all, with __syncthreads minus the same loop without it; 65536 iterations

measurements.name: grid_barrier_ns
measurements.method: 512 back-to-back ModelHarness GridBarriers over a resident grid, one 128-byte-aligned event per barrier, swept over CTAs per SM; the recorded value is the widest grid and the curve carries the rest

bf16.method: per-task barrier/fence protocol, 4096 globaltimer samples; empty-loop subtraction; median across repeats

measurements.method: 2 * memory clock * bus width from cudaDeviceGetAttribute; the pin rate, not an achieved one

measurements.name: dram_drift
